title: Blueprint · A General structure · 七杀格 · 丙 Underfueled · born 2006-12-3 10:00

sections.head: 1 · STRUCTURE
sections.text: Your chart answers to pressure, the hard test and the person who pushes back. You rise when the stakes are real and the deadline is close, and you are steadiest in the thick of a fight.

sections.head: 1 · WHY
sections.text: Nothing hidden in your strongest seat shows on your stems. The General who holds it is the organising force of your life, and you answer to it first.

sections.head: 1 · STATE
sections.text: The Magistrate shows beside your General, and you switch between fighting for ground and asking for it politely. People above you get mixed signals, and you lose credit that one clear approach would win.

sections.head: 1 · WHAT PROTECTS IT
sections.sub: what protects it · Artisan decade 2087 to 2096
sections.text: What you make protects it, work you finish and show, and you find the time to make it in your decades later.

sections.head: 2 · STRONGEST
sections.text: Water and Wood carry three quarters of your chart, and you live mostly through what you answer to and what you think.

sections.head: 2 · MISSING
sections.sub: no Sage · it arrives with your decade 2057 to 2066
sections.text: Your chart holds no Sage, and nobody inside it shelters you or praises you for trying. You learned early to reassure yourself, and you trust help more when you did not have to ask for it.

sections.head: 2 · SEASON
sections.text: Early winter takes the sun out of season, with short days and cold water rising under you. The month wants Wood to keep your fire fed, Earth to hold back the water, and Metal to trim the Wood when it grows thick. You stay bright through the dark months by drawing on each of these as the weather changes.

sections.head: 2 · SEASON NEED
sections.sub: first need · 甲, the Alchemist · inside a branch, not on show
sections.text: The Alchemist your season asks for runs underneath without showing, and you study in private and keep the strangest of what you learn to yourself.

sections.head: 2 · SEASON NEED
sections.sub: second need · 戊, the Artisan · inside a branch, not on show
sections.text: The Artisan your season asks for stays beneath the surface, and you refill yourself through a private craft or a kitchen nobody else uses.

sections.head: 2 · SEASON NEED
sections.sub: second need · 庚, the Horizon · hidden deep
sections.text: Your season asks for the Horizon and your chart keeps only a thin seam of it, and you stumble on your chances late, through a friend of a friend.

sections.head: 2 · SEASON NEED
sections.sub: support · 壬, the General · inside a branch, not on show
sections.text: The General your season asks for works unseen from within, and you hold yourself to a hard private standard that makes you stronger.

sections.head: 3 · IN PLAIN VIEW
sections.text: You come across as someone who carries their own weight and asks for little help.

sections.head: 3 · IN PLAIN VIEW
sections.text: You come across as quick and outspoken, the one who says what the rest of the meeting was thinking.

sections.head: 3 · IN PLAIN VIEW
sections.text: You come across as reliable and correct, the person others trust to follow the rules and keep their word.

sections.head: 3 · INSIDE
sections.text: You want comfort more than you show, good food and an evening with nothing planned.

sections.head: 3 · INSIDE
sections.text: You push yourself harder in private than anyone asks of you, and you set tests that nobody else sees.

sections.head: 3 · INSIDE
sections.text: You think in strange directions and keep most of those thoughts to yourself.

sections.head: 3 · INSIDE
sections.text: In private you want to answer to nobody, and you would rather finish a job alone than wait for a hand.

sections.head: 3 · CLOSE
sections.text: Only the people you live with meet the second list.

sections.head: 4 · PAIRING
sections.sub: The Artisan tames the General · 食神制杀
sections.text: A hard deadline settles you instead of rattling you, and you turn out your best work when the stakes are high and the clock runs short.

sections.head: 4 · PAIRING
sections.sub: The Alchemist starves the Artisan · 枭神夺食
sections.text: Your thinking outweighs your making, and you study a thing so long that the moment to make it passes.

sections.head: 4 · PAIRING
sections.sub: The Virtuoso confronts the Magistrate · 伤官见官
sections.text: Your talent argues with whoever is in charge, and you are at your sharpest where nobody signs off on every line.

sections.head: 4 · BOND
sections.sub: Day binds with Month · 寅亥合
sections.text: You find a partner close to your work or your parents' circle, and the line between your job and your home stays thin for years.

sections.head: 4 · BOND
sections.sub: Hour clashes with Month · 巳亥冲
sections.text: What you built at work in your rising years stops fitting your later life, and you change course in your late forties rather than hold on to it.

sections.head: 4 · BOND
sections.text: A quiet friction runs between your partner and the people after you, and you spend years smoothing over complaints nobody says out loud.

sections.head: 4 · BOND
sections.text: The same argument returns at home between you and the people after you, and you break the loop by changing your own rule first.
